preconditions.description: The number of test cases T is between 1 and 1000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= L <= R <= 10**9 for L, R in (line.split() for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:]))
preconditions.description: For each test case, L and R are integers where 1 ≤ L ≤ R ≤ 10^9.

postconditions.expression: all(len(stdout.splitlines()) == T for stdout in [stdout] if stdout)
postconditions.description: The output contains exactly one line per test case.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= int(line) < 10**9 + 7 for line in stdout.splitlines() if stdout)
postconditions.description: Each output line is a non-negative integer less than 10^9 + 7.

postconditions.expression: all(int(line) == sum(int(x) * len(str(x)) for x in range(int(L), int(R) + 1)) % (10**9 + 7) for L, R, line in zip((line.split()[0] for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:]), (line.split()[1] for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:]), stdout.splitlines()) if stdout)
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output line is the sum of goodness (number multiplied by its digit count) of all integers from L to R inclusive, modulo 10^9 + 7.
